violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Observed pink mold-like debris on the interior and enclosed components of equipment (ice machine) are not being cleaned as required on front drink prepline.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. CDI: CFM cleaned the interior of ice machine on front drink prep line.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold holding equipment: Avantico 2 Dr UC refrigerator and Avantico 1 Dr UC on front drink prepline.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS instructed CFM to place ambient thermometers inside the Avantico 2 Dr UC refrigerator and Avantico 1 Dr UC on front drink prepline.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean glass cups/ serving trays were stored in an manner that exposed the item(s) to contamination (directly under the paper towel dispenser at the front handwashing sink where possible splashing from wet hands may occur).
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. CDI: CFM relocated clean glass cups and serving trays to the clean side drain board at the 3 vat sink (away from possible splashing).

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Avantico 1 Dr UC refrigerator (front drink prepline) ambient temperature 53F at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS instructed CFM to relocate multiple jugs of white whole milk to the Galaxy 1 Dr UR refrigerator to allow for better air flow inside the unit. EHS instructed CFM to ensure the Avantico 1 Dr UC refrigerator (front drink prepline) ambient temperature maintains 41F or below throughout operation.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical quat sanitizing solutions at 3 vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. EHS scheduled follow up inspection to verify quat sanitizer solution test strips are present.
